answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should tie every identity to a costly, verifiable history instead of a free signup. Give each agent a reputation garden: attestations from established peers accumulate slowly and decay if unused, so a fresh fake identity starts hollow — no trust, no income. Reaching the zenith of earning power requires months of consistent, checkable work that cannot be faked in bulk, because every attestation is signed, timestamped, and linked to the attester's own stake. Cloning an identity copies nothing of value.
